reasoning: A rounded square frame with two four-pointed sparkles is widely recognized as the standard symbol for AI tools, auto-enhancement, photo retouching, or making something spotless. It fits tasks centered on LLMs, image enhancement, and deep cleaning, though it shares visual territory with other sparkle and magic-wand icons.
